builder.intro: Paste your FAQ, manual, policy or example Q&A. Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory turns it into chat examples. Review and edit them before training. Token Factory usage is charged to your credits.
builder.roleHint: Who the assistant is, who it talks to and in what tone. Used only to write the examples.
builder.rolePlaceholder: Support agent for an online shoe store. Answers customers politely and briefly.
builder.materialPlaceholder: Paste FAQ, manuals, policies or example Q&A here
builder.materialHint: {{chars}} / {{max}} characters · sent to Nemotron in {{chunks}} parts. Nemotron pulls out the facts, then writes ten differently worded questions for each. Only facts in this text are used.
builder.estimate: Estimate: about {{facts}} facts · about {{examples}} examples · {{calls}} requests · up to {{amount}} (the number of requests depends on the facts found)
builder.estimateMore: More: up to {{examples}} examples from {{facts}} facts · {{calls}} requests · up to {{amount}}
builder.regenerateConfirm: Rebuild? The current examples and your edits will be replaced.
builder.previewHint: Fix wrong facts and remove anything you would not want the model to say. For each fact, one reworded question is marked for evaluation. Those examples are kept out of training and used to test the model later.
builder.needMore: At least {{min}} training examples are needed
builder.emptyRows: Fill in or remove empty examples
builder.noEvalWarning: No examples are held out, so this model cannot be evaluated later
builder.ready: Ready to use as training data
builder.applied: Training data set: {{train}} for training, {{eval}} for evaluation
builder.truncated: The file was cut to the maximum length

evaluation.title: Evaluate with Nemotron
evaluation.description: Sends each held-out question to your deployed model and to the base Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory, then Nemotron grades both answers against the reference answer (1–5). Your endpoint runs while this is in progress, and Token Factory usage is charged to your credits.

blockers.no_eval_set: The deployed fine-tune has no held-out examples. Train again with examples held out for evaluation.

evaluation.plan: {{questions}} questions · baseline {{baseline}} · Token Factory up to {{amount}}
evaluation.paused: Paused. Top up credits or try again, then resume.

verdicts.better: Your model scored higher than the base model on these questions (sign test p {{p}}).
verdicts.worse: Your model scored lower than the base model on these questions (sign test p {{p}}).
verdicts.inconclusive: No clear difference on {{n}} questions (sign test p {{p}}). More held-out questions would be needed to tell.
verdicts.too_few: Only {{n}} questions were graded. That is too few to conclude anything; treat the numbers as examples.

evaluation.footnote: {{n}} graded, {{failed}} not graded · sign test p {{p}} · 95% bootstrap interval of the score difference: {{interval}} · baseline {{baseline}} · grader {{judge}} · Token Factory {{amount}}
evaluation.judgeInvalid: The grader's answer could not be read, so this question was skipped
evaluation.itemFailed: No answer, so this question was skipped

demoGuide.title: A model built end to end with Forkline
demoGuide.body: Midori Bakery FAQ is Nemotron 3 Nano 4B fine-tuned with LoRA on a Nebius Serverless AI Job, using 231 chat examples that Nemotron on Token Factory wrote from a bakery FAQ. 26 held-out questions were kept for evaluation. Below is a conversation with this model, recorded from its Nebius endpoint.
